BillHeading.BriefDescription: Exempting state highway projects from local ordinances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting state highway projects from local ordinances; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 35A.21 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any ordinance adopted by a city or town does not apply to a department of transportation project on a state highway as defined in RCW 46.04.560.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any ordinance adopted by a code city does not apply to a department of transportation project on a state highway as defined in RCW 46.04.560.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 3. A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Any ordinance adopted by a county does not apply to a department of transportation project on a state highway as defined in RCW 46.04.560.
